scope: read-only PnP enumeration; no driver change, no chip initialization, no radio frame

chipIdentity.method: devourer reads SYS_CFG2 0x00FC during Init (RTL8821C expected 0x09); that writes chip state and needs explicit authorization

notes: VID/PID and the Windows device name say RTL8821CU, but they do not prove the silicon revision.
Current binding is the Realtek/Microsoft netrtwlanu driver; libusb access will require a WinUSB binding of interface MI_02.
The adapter is attached through a Genesys Logic hub (05e3:0608); a direct motherboard port is preferred for the binding experiment.
Full instance paths and serial numbers stay in evidence/usb-devices.local.json, which is git-ignored.
